kurzbeschreibung: The Notburga Museum in Eben am Achensee is Austria's only museum dedicated to Tyrol's most popular folk saint and maidservant Notburga.
beschreibung:
Veneration of the Tyrolean Patron Saint of Servants

In the picturesque village of Eben am Achensee stands the Notburga Museum, directly adjoining the historic pilgrimage church. It is the only museum in the Alpine region dedicated to the life, deeds, and deeply rooted veneration of Heilige Notburga.

Historical Exhibits and Sacred Folk Art

The exhibition in the former vicarage displays precious Baroque paintings, processional poles, votive pictures, and artisan crafts spanning several centuries. Visitors gain an impressive insight into why the humble maidservant from Rattenberg remains a role model of charity and social care to this day.
